questions.q: Core (energy quiz in the portal): 12 questions on stores, transfers, conservation, KE, power and cost.
questions.model: Teacher goes through question 1 first: 'Name the energy store of a book on a shelf.' Gravitational potential.

questions.q: Extend: Show by calculation whether an 8 W LED or a 60 W bulb is cheaper to run for 1000 hours at 25p per kWh.
questions.a: LED: 8 kWh = £2; old bulb: 60 kWh = £15; the LED saves £13.

questions.q: Stretch: Explain why a hot drink cools but the room does not noticeably warm, using conservation of energy.
questions.a: Energy from the drink spreads out among the very large mass of air and surroundings, raising its temperature only slightly.

questions.q: Big question: how can we use energy wisely?
questions.a: Choose efficient, lower-power appliances, use them for less time and avoid waste, which also saves money.
